scripts.build: npm run build --prefix frontend && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); if (!fs.existsSync('dist') && fs.existsSync('frontend/dist')) fs.cpSync('frontend/dist', 'dist', {recursive: true}); if (!fs.existsSync('frontend/dist') && fs.existsSync('dist')) fs.cpSync('dist', 'frontend/dist', {recursive: true});"
